description: Every line on the notice is correct, but the printed 'Maximum You May Be Billed' total for the first claim is $12.50 higher than the sum of its lines. The page-1 summary total inherits the same $12.50 overstatement. Tests whether a reader re-adds columns rather than trusting printed totals.

sources.what: MSN claim-total rows and the 'Maximum You May Be Billed' column
MSN content and format specifications (totals per claim)
sources.source: CMS Medicare Claims Processing Manual, Pub. 100-04, ch. 21 §10.3, https://www.cms.gov/regulations-and-guidance/guidance/manuals/downloads/clm104c21.pdf

sources.what: Error definition: math-error is an internal-consistency check, no external rule
